spec_provided_observability.name: Status Register (Read Status 70h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-LUN composite status byte: WP_n / RDY / ARDY / VSP / CSP / R / FAILC / FAIL. RDY=0 invalidates all other bits except WP_n.

spec_provided_observability.name: Read Status Enhanced (78h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-LUN-per-plane status; turns off other LUNs' output buffers — required for multi-LUN debug.

spec_provided_observability.name: R/B_n open-drain pin
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Real-time busy line; LOW when any LUN is busy. External pull-up; observable on bench LA without ONFI traffic.

spec_provided_observability.name: Read ID (90h, address 00h/20h/40h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Manufacturer + Device ID + ONFI/JEDEC signature; confirms device responds and identifies which silicon revision is present.

spec_provided_observability.name: Read Unique ID (EDh)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 16-byte UID with bit-wise complement repeated 16 times — host can validate retrieval correctness with no side effects.

spec_provided_observability.name: Get Features (EEh + feature_addr)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Reads back currently programmed feature parameters (timing mode, drive strength, ODT, etc.).

spec_provided_observability.name: ECC threshold (CSP bit in Status, EZ NAND)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Signals that ECC correctability is approaching limit — host can rewrite the page to a fresh location.

scope_observability: Logic-analyzer or oscilloscope probing of CE_n / CLE / ALE / WE_n / RE_n / DQ[7:0] is the standard SDR debug path.
For NV-DDR family, add CLK, DQS_t, DQS_c probes; differential probes recommended for NV-DDR2 (800 MT/s) and NV-DDR3 (1.2 GT/s).
R/B_n probe directly shows tPROG / tBERS / tR durations without parsing protocol.
Read DQ Training pattern (62h, NV-DDR3) is fixed and well-known — useful for eye-diagram capture.
Write TX DQ Training (63h pattern / 64h readback) provides round-trip pattern check for write-path eye centering.

training_for_diagnostic.name: Implicit DCC Training (18h)
training_for_diagnostic.purpose: NV-DDR3 only; duty-cycle correction on internal clock.

training_for_diagnostic.name: Read DQ Training (62h)
training_for_diagnostic.purpose: Host sweeps RX sampling phase; device outputs fixed pattern; host finds optimal eye-center.

training_for_diagnostic.name: Write TX DQ Training Pattern (63h)
training_for_diagnostic.purpose: Host writes a training pattern to the device's training register.

training_for_diagnostic.name: Write TX DQ Training Readback (64h)
training_for_diagnostic.purpose: Device returns the previously written pattern; host adjusts TX phase based on round-trip success.

training_for_diagnostic.name: Write RX DQ Training (76h)
training_for_diagnostic.purpose: Device performs RX-side per-DQ training using host-driven pattern.

training_for_diagnostic.name: ZQ Calibration Long (F9h) / Short (D9h)
training_for_diagnostic.purpose: Calibrates output driver impedance to RZQ × 1/N reference for NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3.

ate_or_dft: Internal scan / BIST / charge-pump diagnostics are vendor-specific and not visible to the host via ONFI commands. Vendor wafer-/package-level test is performed before assembly and is not exposed at the package interface.
notes: ONFI provides extensive protocol-level observability (status register, parameter page CRC, unique-ID retrieval check, optional ECC threshold report) plus NV-DDR3-specific PHY training observables (Read DQ Training, Write TX DQ Training Readback). However ONFI does not specify a JTAG / scan / boundary-scan port on the NAND package — internal die test is vendor-specific. Bench debug is typically a combination of (a) ONFI protocol analyzer (decoding cmd/addr/data cycles), (b) R/B_n scope probe for timing, (c) DQ eye scope for SI debug, (d) Read Status Enhanced polling for per-LUN fault isolation.
